final: WITH grouped AS (SELECT ordersmark, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), total AS (SELECT SUM(record_count) AS n FROM grouped), ratios AS (SELECT g.ordersmark, g.record_count, CAST(g.record_count AS REAL) / t.n AS share FROM grouped AS g CROSS JOIN total AS t WHERE t.n IS NOT NULL), mean AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM ratios) SELECT r.ordersmark, r.record_count, r.share, r.share - m.average_share FROM ratios AS r CROSS JOIN mean AS m WHERE m.average_share IS NOT NULL ORDER BY r.share - m.average_share DESC LIMIT 10
